response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, and demonstrates strong engineering discipline (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, public talks). However, the role is fundamentally a hands-on C++ position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2015 plus a university thesis project. There is no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, message-broker or MQTT work, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), or Secure Development Lifecycle / IEC 62443 experience, which are the core and security requirements of the posting. His recent decade is almost entirely TypeScript/Node/D-lang product work, so the gap to the required stack and domain is large despite the strong general seniority.
strengths: Deep senior-level breadth: 15+ years across embedded, backend, and full-stack roles
Proven high-performance, low-latency distributed systems work (async I/O, fibers, millions of req/s)
Strong quality and mentoring culture: TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source test tooling
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, MQTT, or OT protocol exposure
No Azure, and limited evidence of UML/architecture documentation practice

key_factors.factor: Missing industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443/SDL) and automation domain
